newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE wheat firmer, volume limited.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE wheat firmer, volume limited.

text.p: LIFFE wheat ended marginally firmer, but with volume limited while barley was tightly mixed.
Buyers held the initiative, one trader said.
There were enough of them around to prevent a firm sterling hitting the market too hard, he said. Profit taking on a widening wheat/barley spread had helped barley.
On wheat, active March last traded 0.45 stg higher at 88.75 stg in volume of 147 lots out of a total 185 lots.
November was most active on barley, with 70 of the 134 lots done. It last traded unchanged at 79.55 stg. --Christopher Lyddon, London newsroom +44 171 542 7928
